description:
You are the CRM Manager responsible for customer data quality at a B2B software company. The FreeScout customer database has incomplete profiles that need to be enriched before a sales handoff meeting. Log in at http://localhost:8080 with admin@helpdesk.local / Admin123!.

Complete the following tasks:
1. Find customer Marisa Obrien (carrollallison@example.com) and update her profile: set Company to 'Pinnacle Systems', Phone to '+1-415-555-0192', and Job Title to 'Senior Systems Engineer'
2. Find customer Nicolas Wilson (joshua24@example.com) and update his profile: set Company to 'Horizon Analytics', Phone to '+1-212-555-0847'
3. Create a brand new customer: First Name 'David', Last Name 'Okafor', Email 'david.okafor@techfirm.io', Company 'TechFirm Solutions', Phone '+1-650-555-0312'
4. Find all conversations belonging to Marisa Obrien (there are 3) and tag each one with 'vip-client'
5. Create a new conversation in the 'Technical Support' mailbox for David Okafor with subject 'New enterprise account onboarding request' and message body: 'Hello, we are a new enterprise client and need assistance setting up our account environment. Please assign a dedicated onboarding specialist to our account.'
